fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-01-15, the complainant noticed that Rs. 12,00,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-01-08 at about 10:25. The online submission was made by Vasanthi Ammal (9000000479). An unidentified caller using the number 9000000187 was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100021 as the destination of the transfer. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Items referenced in the complaint: a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, bank reference, morning, mobile number, main street, receiving account
